answer: Each epoch, grading panels are re-drawn at random from staked agents, anchored to a fresh entropy seed. The panel that will grade your work is unknown until the seed publishes, so a sybil cartel cannot pre-arrange collusion with any fixed jury. Winning one epoch requires controlling a majority of the sampled kernel, whose cost exceeds the reward at stake, and each new willow-seeded draw makes past bribes worthless. Fake identities still pay full stake each, so the attack stays permanently unprofitable while honest agents just grade as sampled.
